name: Altus AFB
description: Home of the 97th Air Mobility Wing. Primary training base for C-17 Globemaster III, KC-46 Pegasus, and KC-135 Stratotanker aircrews.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate (Falcon Road)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate. After-hours visitor passes issued here when VCC closed (up to 72 hours).

gates.name: South Gate (Challenger Blvd)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1700; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Weekday commuter gate on Challenger Boulevard.

gates.name: Jasmine Gate (North)
gates.notes: 24/7 north-side gate. Convenient for Friendship and Martha communities.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1700; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Located outside South Gate. Day passes up to 14 days. REAL ID required. Phone: 580-481-6340.

resources.name: Hangar 97 Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Primary DFAC with Burger Grill, Ciao Pizza, Super Sonic Subs, salad bar, rotating grill, and Touch & Go 1930-0200.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Bfast 0600-0800, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1630-1830; Sat-Sun: Bfast 0730-0830, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1630-1800; Touch & Go 1930-0200 daily
resources.address: 208 S 6th St, Bldg 317, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Altus Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, shoppette, Class Six, barber, and clothing sales.

resources.name: Red River Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union with ATM in commissary parking lot.

resources.name: 97th Medical Group Clinic
resources.description: Primary care and TRICARE support for the mobility training wing. No emergency department — call 911.
resources.address: 301 N 1st St, Bldg 46, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Altus Fitness Center
resources.description: 24/7 fitness facility with weight rooms, CrossFit area, saunas, group exercise, and indoor pool access.
resources.address: 209 S 6th St, Bldg 156, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for training students and unaccompanied personnel.

resources.name: Housing Office
resources.description: On-base family housing referrals and off-base housing counseling.
resources.address: 401 L Ave, Bldg 358, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Red River Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: 226 transient bed spaces including VQ, TLF, and DV suites. 24-hour front desk.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100
resources.address: 307 B Ave, Bldg 82, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Airman & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, transition assistance, and family programs.
resources.address: 308 N 1st St, Bldg 52, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: 97th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory
resources.address: 308 N 1st St, Bldg 52, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Military Personnel Section (MPS)
resources.description: In-processing, CAC/ID cards, DEERS, assignments, and personnel actions.
resources.address: 308 N 1st St, Bldg 52, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rental, RV storage, auto hobby shop, and recreational programs.
resources.address: 500 S 1st St, Bldg 343, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Windy Trails Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole par 72 course with bent-grass greens, pro shop, and 24-hour driving range.
resources.address: 209 Fir Dr, Bldg 35, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Galaxy Bowling Lanes & Grill
resources.description: 12 lanes with programmable bumpers, Galaxy Grill breakfast and lunch, and league play.

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access registration. REAL ID required.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1700; closed weekends and federal holidays

events.title: Story Time
events.description: Join us for Library Story Time and enjoy a fun-filled morning of stories, songs, rhymes, and a creative craft! It’s the perfect opportunity for babies, toddlers, and young children to learn, laugh, and explore alongside their caregivers. Suggested for ages 0–6. For more information, please call 580-481-6302.

events.title: Murder Mystery Game Night
events.description: Come and be part of our Murder Mystery Game Night! Collaborate as a team to unravel an exciting murder mystery, where everyone has an important part to play, exchanging clues and notes to solve the case. Snacks and beverages will be available. Recommended age is 14+. For more information, please call 481-6302.

events.title: Texas Hold ‘Em
events.location: Altus AFB Dark Horse Sports Bar
events.description: Get ready for an exciting Thursday night at the Dark Horse Sports Bar with Texas Hold ’Em from 1800 – 2100! Test your poker skills, enjoy great company, and compete for bragging rights in a fun and lively atmosphere. Club members play for free, and non-members can join the action for just $5. Don’t miss one of the best weekly hangouts on base! For more information, please call 481-7034.

events.title: The Breadwinner
events.description: FREE MOVIE AT THE BASE THEATER! Join us at the Base Theater for a FREE showing of The Breadwinner, rated PG! Grab your family and friends and enjoy a movie on the big screen. Concessions will be available for purchase. For more information, please call 580-481-6600.

events.title: Pumpkin Pacer 10K
events.description: Fitness Center Pumpkin Pacer 10K run starting at 0800.

events.title: Swoktoberfest (Southwest Oklahoma Fest)
events.description: Live music, food and drinks, corn hole, bounce houses, and more.

events.title: Toy Story 5
events.description: To infinity, beyond…and the Base Theater! Bring the family and enjoy a FREE showing of Toy Story 5, rated PG, at the Base Theater! Grab your favorite movie snacks from the concession stand, sit back, and enjoy Woody, Buzz, and the gang on the big screen. Admission is FREE! Concessions will be available. For more information, please call 580-481-6600.

events.title: 1 Best Ball of 2
events.description: Grab a partner and hit the greens at Windy Trails Golf Course for the 1 Best Ball of 2 Tournament! Compete in two-person teams where every great shot counts as you battle it out for the best score on the course. Tee off begins at 0900, and entry is just $15 per golfer. Don’t miss a fun day of competition, teamwork, and great golf! For more information, please call 580-481-7207.

events.title: Harry Potter Teen Trivia
events.description: Join the Library for the Harry Potter Teen Trivia from 1100 - 1300 Represent your Hogwarts House and test your Harry Potter knowledge! Suggested age 13+. For more information, please call 580-481-6302

events.title: Halloween Bowling
events.description: Halloween Bowling at Galaxy Lanes! Get ready for a spooktacular afternoon of bowling from 1200-1800 at Galaxy Lanes! Bowlers who come dressed in costume can enjoy $2 games per person and $1 shoe rental! Kids Costume Contest at 1500! Come dressed to impress and show off your best Halloween look! Bring the whole family for an afternoon of bowling, costumes, and Halloween fun! For more information, please call 580-481-6

events.title: Turkey Shoot Two-Man Scramble
events.description: Grab your favorite golf partner and head out to Windy Trails Golf Course for the Turkey Shoot Two-Man Scramble! Tee off begins at 1000 for a fun-filled day of competition, camaraderie, and great golf. Entry is just $20 per golfer, making it the perfect chance to enjoy the course and test your skills with friends. For more information, please call 580-481-7207.

events.title: Gobble Trot 5K
events.description: Start the Thanksgiving season off on the right foot at the Fitness Center's Gobble Trot 5K! Lace up your running shoes and join us for a fun and festive morning run beginning at 0700. Whether you're racing for a personal best or just coming out for the holiday spirit, it's the perfect way to kick off the season with friends, family, and fitness fun!

events.title: Holiday Tree Lighting
events.description: Celebrate the start of the holiday season with your Air Force family at the Holiday Tree Lighting at Wings of Freedom Park! Enjoy an evening filled with holiday cheer, festive spirit, and community fun as we light up the season together. Festivities begin at 1700 - don't miss this magical holiday tradition!

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to Military Personnel Section (580-481-5307) in Bldg 52 upon arrival. Training students contact dorm management at 580-481-5218.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Red River Inn (580-481-7356) for temporary lodging. Housing Office at 401 L Ave (580-481-7235) for family housing. Dorm management at 580-481-5218.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 97 FSS and M&FRC for in-processing and community support.
